message.nexus.controlador_forja.incomple: The forge structure is incomplete. Missing blocks were highlighted.
nexus.configuration.title: Nexus Configs
message.nexus.coletor.tipo_incorreto: Select non-elemental mana to use the collector.
message.nexus.coletor.alvo_automatico: Fixed target removed. The collector will choose automatically again.
message.nexus.coletor.alvo_definido: Collector target set to X:%1$s Y:%2$s Z:%3$s.
message.nexus.coletor.alvo_atual: Current fixed target: X:%1$s Y:%2$s Z:%3$s.
message.nexus.coletor.alvo_atual_automat: Current target: automatic, prioritizing blocks up to %1$s blocks away.
death.attack.krefty_tijolo: %1$s was hit by a brick from %2$s's Krefty
death.attack.bastry_counter: %1$s got their own hit back from %2$s's Bastry
death.attack.escordy_chumbo: %1$s was riddled with pellets by %2$s's Escordy
death.attack.rifty_magia: %1$s was torn apart by the dimension %2$s ripped open
death.attack.rifty_vazio: %1$s was swallowed by the void of %2$s's Rifty
message.nexus.relictooltip.na_outra_mao_: In the off hand, with the Krefty and Instant Construction selected. H key rotates.
message.nexus.relictooltip.segure_shift_: Hold Shift or Ctrl to see the skills
message.nexus.relictooltip.tecla_da_reli: Relic key: use the selected active skill
message.nexus.nexuscommands.maestria_de_: Mastery of %s set to %s for %s player(s).
relic.nexus.agrix.olhe_para_um_mob_pacif: Look at a passive mob (up to %s blocks).
relic.nexus.agrix.esse_mob_nao_tem_ovo: This mob has no spawn egg.
relic.nexus.agrix.ressonancia_rank_a_ou_: Resonance rank A or higher and at least 3 kinds of seeds or crops in the inventory (consumed).
relic.nexus.agrix.skill.0.desc: Hostile mobs you kill turn into a crop on the ground (dirt, grass or sand) or drop a seed. Animals you breed may have twins.
relic.nexus.agrix.skill.1.desc: Mark two points: plants, saplings and trees get bone meal every 1.5s for a while.
relic.nexus.agrix.skill.2.desc: Mark two points: babies grow faster and animals can breed again sooner.
relic.nexus.agrix.skill.3.desc: Turns the passive mob you are looking at into its spawn egg, keeping all its data.
relic.nexus.agrix.skill.4.desc: Mark two points: for 20s, hostile mobs inside become passive mobs forever.
message.nexus.relic.mire_em_um_bloco_ate: Aim at a block (up to %s blocks).
message.nexus.relic.ponto_1_marcado_mire: Point 1 marked. Aim at point 2 and use again (Shift cancels).
message.nexus.relic.area_grande_demais_m: Area too large (max. %s blocks per side).
relic.nexus.bastry.capacidade_rank_a_ou_: Capacity rank A or higher, health at 75%% or less or charge at 75%% or more, and every other Bastry skill on cooldown.
relic.nexus.bastry.skill.0.desc: Blocked damage turns into charge (limited by mastery and Capacity). With full charge, damage goes through. The charge decays over time and is spent on the next hit: it deals whichever is higher, the charge damage or the item damage.
relic.nexus.bastry.skill.1.desc: 2-block field for ~10s that sends projectiles back to the shooter. Whoever is inside is protected; you can't use projectiles while it lasts.
relic.nexus.bastry.skill.2.desc: For 10s, take only half of melee damage and return double what you took. No shield during this time.
relic.nexus.bastry.skill.3.desc: Spends the charge and turns it into resistances (25%%, 50%%, 75%% and 100%% of the charge).
relic.nexus.bastry.skill.4.desc: For 30s, ignore all damage (except void and /kill) and negative effects. The charge turns bad effects into good ones.
relic.nexus.brekry.nada_para_abrir_nessa: Nothing to dig in this direction.
relic.nexus.brekry.afinidade_rank_a_ou_m: Affinity rank A or higher and 64 TNT in the inventory (consumed).
relic.nexus.brekry.skill.0.desc: Plants a bomb that explodes in 5s, breaking blocks. Deals no damage to entities.
relic.nexus.brekry.skill.1.desc: Digs a horizontal tunnel ahead (1×2×5, grows with Affinity). Doesn't break blocks with an inventory.
relic.nexus.brekry.skill.2.desc: Mining speed for a few seconds.
relic.nexus.brekry.skill.3.desc: Clears 10×10×10 ahead (except ores, chests and blocks near liquids) and stores everything in a double chest.
relic.nexus.brekry.skill.4.desc: For 10s, any block breaks instantly and drops itself, even naturally unbreakable ones.
relic.nexus.brutix.furia_em_pelo_menos_m: Fury at at least half of the maximum stages.
relic.nexus.brutix.skill.0.desc: Taking damage fills the fury; each full bar grants a strength stage (3, up to 5 with mastery). After ~10s without damage, lose one stage at a time.
relic.nexus.brutix.skill.1.desc: Throws the axe up to 10 blocks (+2 per fury stage); it comes back to you, cutting on the way out and back.
relic.nexus.brutix.skill.2.desc: Spins for 3s hitting and pushing everyone around. Spends the fury: more stages, more damage and radius.
relic.nexus.brutix.skill.3.desc: A roar that weakens and pushes back nearby enemies (stronger with fury, without spending it).
relic.nexus.brutix.skill.4.desc: Brutal diagonal slash ahead: high base damage + bonus per spent stage. Afterwards, weakness and fury disabled for 10s.
relic.nexus.chiefy.2_stacks_de_comida_no: 2 stacks of food in the inventory (spent).
relic.nexus.chiefy.skill.0.desc: Food dropped by mobs you kill comes already cooked and improved (+50%% hunger and saturation).
relic.nexus.chiefy.skill.1.desc: The mob hit turns into a food piñata. Against players and bosses, only damage (players lose hunger).
relic.nexus.chiefy.skill.2.desc: Seasons up to 16 foods in the inventory: each kind grants a good effect for 30s when eaten.
relic.nexus.chiefy.skill.3.desc: For 15s, food rains on whoever is in the area. Enemies who eat too much (4 hits) explode.
relic.nexus.chiefy.skill.4.desc: For 30s, 5-block area: enemies fill a counter and, when full, eat until they explode. Allies are fed.
relic.nexus.colossy.skill.0.desc: Worn: you grow bigger and gain, in the same proportion, health, damage, defense and jump (10%% to 30%%), +0.5 block of reach.
relic.nexus.colossy.skill.1.desc: Punches the ground: damage in a 4-block area and Slowness II for 3s.
relic.nexus.colossy.skill.2.desc: Attacking an ownerless passive animal eats it: restores 50%% health and all hunger (1 min cooldown).
relic.nexus.colossy.skill.3.desc: Stomp ahead (3x3): damage and shrinks those hit by half for 10s.
relic.nexus.colossy.skill.4.desc: At low health, the next hit becomes an uppercut that launches the target ~20 blocks up and stuns it on landing.
relic.nexus.cryoni.precisa_de_10s_de_his: Needs 10s of history in the same dimension.
relic.nexus.cryoni.skill.0.desc: Immune to fire, lava and cold. Enemies within 1.5 blocks of you freeze (like in powder snow) in 2s.
relic.nexus.cryoni.skill.1.desc: 5-block field for 10s where everything moves at 50%% speed (bosses 30%%).
relic.nexus.cryoni.skill.2.desc: Goes back 10 seconds in time: position, health, hunger and effects from that moment.
relic.nexus.cryoni.skill.3.desc: For 5s, time stops in a 20-block radius: only you move. Your hits stack and all land at the end.
relic.nexus.cryoni.skill.4.desc: 5 freezing waves up to 30 blocks: 3 waves freeze for 20s; all 5 turn into an ice statue (guaranteed death).
relic.nexus.cultry.coma_antes_uma_pilula: First eat a pill of the previous grade.
relic.nexus.cultry.seu_corpo_ja_absorveu: Your body has already absorbed the maximum of this grade.
relic.nexus.cultry.fique_parado_e_agacha: Stand still and crouch to meditate.
relic.nexus.cultry.nivel_100_de_xp_vida: XP level 100, full health and hunger, and having already eaten a superior pill.
relic.nexus.cultry.skill.0.desc: Hits burn. Killed mobs turn into pills that raise attributes forever. Right click refines the pills.
relic.nexus.cultry.skill.1.desc: Still and crouching, you meditate: restore health and hunger, gain mastery XP and XP (doubled).
relic.nexus.cultry.skill.2.desc: Throws the cauldron: a growing suction field that burns and turns mobs into pills.
relic.nexus.cultry.skill.3.desc: 8 palm pulses around you, up to 16 blocks, that hurt and push (even bosses).
relic.nexus.cultry.skill.4.desc: Calls the tribulation: lightning on enemies and 3 on you. If you survive, you become Immortal for 1 minute.
relic.nexus.domix.olhar_para_um_pet_seu: Look at one of your pets at full health that is looking at you.
relic.nexus.domix.skill.0.desc: Right click with the relic instantly tames any ownerless tameable mob.
relic.nexus.domix.skill.1.desc: Summons 5 stronger temporary wolves (Affinity) for 20–60s. They attack nearby hostiles and vanish without drops.
relic.nexus.domix.skill.2.desc: Your pets within 10 blocks become immune to damage for 10s (you don't).
relic.nexus.domix.skill.3.desc: Summons 6 to 10 random temporary pets for ~20s.
relic.nexus.domix.skill.4.desc: Look at one of your pets: you gain its power for 1–2 min and the pet disappears until it ends. Llama, camel and nautilus: the relic key uses the power.
relic.nexus.draconix.o_dragao_esta_com_a: The dragon has your skin. Put it away first.
relic.nexus.draconix.o_dragao_voltou_par: The dragon went back into the egg. Your powers are back.
relic.nexus.draconix.o_ovo_ainda_nao_cho: The egg hasn't hatched yet: defeat the Ender Dragon, throw dragon's breath into lava and step into the purple lava without skin and without armor.
relic.nexus.draconix.desligue_a_pele_esc: Turn off Scaly Skin: the dragon needs its skin.
relic.nexus.draconix.seu_dragao_caiu_e_v: Your dragon fell and went back into the egg. It takes 30 minutes to hatch again.
relic.nexus.draconix.o_ovo_chocou_ative_: The egg hatched! Activate The True Dragon to call it.
relic.nexus.draconix.a_pele_escamosa_nao: Scaly Skin doesn't allow wearing armor.
relic.nexus.draconix.skill.0.desc: Night Vision; hostiles within 8 blocks flee from you; endermen don't get angry; players who stare at you deal 2%% less damage.
relic.nexus.draconix.skill.1.desc: Cone breath (8 blocks): damage and draconic fire (water doesn't put it out, ignores Fire Resistance).
relic.nexus.draconix.skill.2.desc: Crouch + right click turns on the skin: armor above netherite, immune to fire and lava. No regular armor.
relic.nexus.draconix.skill.3.desc: With the skin on, you get wings to glide; right click while gliding gives a boost (5%% of mana).
relic.nexus.draconix.skill.4.desc: Hatching (once): defeat the Ender Dragon, throw dragon's breath into lava and step into the purple lava without skin and without armor. Activating calls the dragon (already mounted if you are falling or flying) or puts it away. While it is out, Breath becomes its giant breath, right click while mounted gives a roar that scares and weakens, and the relic's passives go to the dragon. If it dies, 30 min to hatch again.
relic.nexus.dwarky.ninguem_por_perto_vel: Nobody nearby: speed and super jump!
relic.nexus.dwarky.home_run_segure_o_cli: Home Run: hold right click to charge and hit the target.
relic.nexus.dwarky.1_pack_64_de_pedra: 1 stack (64) of stone in the inventory (tag nexus:pedras_quebra_montanha), consumed.
relic.nexus.dwarky.skill.0.desc: With the mace in hand: 75%% size and fall resistance (partial, total at max mastery).
relic.nexus.dwarky.skill.1.desc: For 10s it becomes a flail: hits strike 3×3×3 (50%% on the others) and reach increases a bit.
relic.nexus.dwarky.skill.2.desc: High jump with an area attack on landing (up to 5 blocks ahead). No targets: speed and super jump.
relic.nexus.dwarky.skill.3.desc: Arms the Home Run: hold right click to charge; the next hit sends the target flying.
relic.nexus.dwarky.skill.4.desc: The mace becomes giant and crushes the area ahead: huge damage and the target shrinks for 15–20s.
relic.nexus.elixy.2_pocoes_de_efeitos_di: 2 potions with different effects in the inventory (spent).
relic.nexus.elixy.skill.0.desc: Every negative effect on you becomes its opposite (same level and duration). Nausea is canceled.
relic.nexus.elixy.skill.1.desc: Throws a potion with 1 to 5 random negative effects. 10s cooldown per effect.
relic.nexus.elixy.skill.2.desc: Creates a potion with a random positive effect (level III or higher) for 1 minute.
relic.nexus.elixy.skill.3.desc: A potion that turns ownerless mobs into gold. Against players and bosses, Instant Damage I damage.
relic.nexus.elixy.skill.4.desc: For 30s, 10-block area: hostiles become passive forever; enemies lose good effects and gain bad ones every second.
relic.nexus.escordy.municao_alternativa_: Alternative Ammo: the next shot is fireworks.
relic.nexus.escordy.regeneracao_rank_a_o: Regeneration rank A or higher, some mob or player within 5 blocks and no charge in reserve.
relic.nexus.escordy.skill.0.desc: No arrows: each reload spends mana and adds 1 charge (10, up to 20 with mastery). Each charge is a pellet; more pellets, wider cone. Strong up close. Click fires; Shift + held click reloads more.
relic.nexus.escordy.skill.1.desc: For ~10s, reloads very fast and a bit cheaper.
relic.nexus.escordy.skill.2.desc: For a few seconds, always at charge 5, without reloading or spending mana. The stored charge comes back afterwards.
relic.nexus.escordy.skill.3.desc: The next shot becomes fireworks (up to 5 rockets), stronger with more charge. You take no damage.
relic.nexus.escordy.skill.4.desc: For ~2 min: 50-charge limit, pellets with random effects and a chance to become a rocket. At the end, the charge becomes reserve shots.
relic.nexus.eterny.skill.0.desc: In hand, it works as an unlimited totem of undying, with a fixed 2-minute cooldown.
relic.nexus.eterny.skill.1.desc: 5-block area that follows you for 10s and heals you, your pets and your team. Full health becomes absorption.
relic.nexus.eterny.skill.2.desc: 3-block area for 5–10s: damage from mobs and players on allies becomes absorption (capped).
relic.nexus.eterny.skill.3.desc: Extra Life (10 min) on you, allies and pets within 10 blocks: they survive one death.
relic.nexus.eterny.skill.4.desc: Explodes, pushing enemies away; for 1 min you are half size, with speed and regeneration, but half max health.
relic.nexus.explory.precisa_de_um_chao_f: Needs solid, free ground for the campfire.
relic.nexus.explory.nenhuma_casa_nesta_d: No home in this dimension (crouch and use to mark one).
relic.nexus.explory.o_rastreador_com_um_: The Tracker with a target and Back from the Adventure ready.
relic.nexus.explory.skill.0.desc: Crouch + right click opens your personal backpack (9 slots, 27 at level 10, 54 at 20). Kept on death.
relic.nexus.explory.skill.1.desc: Right click picks a structure and the compass points to it (village; temples and outposts; fortresses and ancient city).
relic.nexus.explory.skill.2.desc: Camp for 10 min: respawn point, a campfire that heals allies and an area without hostile mobs.
relic.nexus.explory.skill.3.desc: Teleports to this dimension's home (3s warm-up, takes allies within 3 blocks). Crouching, marks the home again.
relic.nexus.explory.skill.4.desc: Teleports the group to the Tracker's structure; the next Back from the Adventure brings you back.
relic.nexus.fisgy.peixe_da_vida_fisgue_u: Fish of Life: hook a mob.
relic.nexus.fisgy.peixe_da_vida_nao_pega: Fish of Life doesn't catch aquatic creatures.
relic.nexus.fisgy.1_pack_64_de_peixes: 1 stack (64) of fish in the inventory (any fish counts), consumed.
relic.nexus.fisgy.skill.0.desc: Fish out of water (dirt, sand, snow, lava, Nether, End), each place with its own fish table. Reeling in without a fish while the bobber is stuck on a block (floor, wall or ceiling) pulls you to it, like a grappling hook.
relic.nexus.fisgy.skill.1.desc: Hook a mob: it loses the health of a random aquatic creature, which appears beside it. If it can't take it, it turns into a fish.
relic.nexus.fisgy.skill.2.desc: Fish rain around you: they hit and vanish; the ones that miss become real fish on the ground.
relic.nexus.fisgy.skill.3.desc: Hook a target: a shark mouth comes out of the ground and bites. In water, it drags them to the bottom.
relic.nexus.fisgy.skill.4.desc: Spends 64 fish and releases a straight-line fish tornado that pulls, spins and throws enemies.
relic.nexus.gravix.gravidade_manipulada_: Gravity Shift ready: hit a target.
relic.nexus.gravix.em_deriva_gravidade_z: Drifting (Zero Gravity on) and Zone 0 on cooldown.
relic.nexus.gravix.skill.0.desc: Crouch + jump turns off gravity (drifting, spending mana); repeat to turn it back on. Immune to fall damage.
relic.nexus.gravix.skill.1.desc: For 15s, heavy gravity in a 5-block radius: Slowness, no high jumps or elytra, enemy projectiles fall.
relic.nexus.gravix.skill.2.desc: For 15s, zero gravity in a 5-block radius: enemies float and drift; when it ends, whoever is high up falls.
relic.nexus.gravix.skill.3.desc: The next hit changes the target's gravity toward where you are looking, for 5s (3s upward).
relic.nexus.gravix.skill.4.desc: For 10s, gravity pulses in a 30-block radius: damage, slowness, root and shrink (stronger close to you).
relic.nexus.grimy.segure_o_clique_direit: Hold right click for the Arcane Ray.
relic.nexus.grimy.precisa_de_pelo_menos_: Needs at least half of the mana.
relic.nexus.grimy.agachar_clique_direito: Crouch + right click: choose page. Right click or relic key: cast.
relic.nexus.grimy.skill.0.desc: Pages 1 and 2: Magic Missile (homing) and Arcane Shield.
relic.nexus.grimy.skill.1.desc: Pages 3 and 4: Fireball and Magic Reflection.
relic.nexus.grimy.skill.2.desc: Pages 5 and 6: Arcane Ray (hold click) and YNP (barrier).
relic.nexus.grimy.skill.3.desc: Pages 7 and 8: Destroyer Flash and Explosion.
relic.nexus.grimy.skill.4.desc: Pages 9 and 10 (finals, spend the full mana): Dooom and Super Nova.
relic.nexus.krefty.mire_em_um_bloco_a: Aim at a block up to %s blocks away.
relic.nexus.krefty.blocos_de_duas_partes: Two-part blocks only from the off hand.
relic.nexus.krefty.mire_em_um_bloco_ate: Aim at a block (up to %s blocks).
relic.nexus.krefty.ponto_1_marcado_mire_: Point 1 marked. Aim at point 2 and use again (Shift cancels).
relic.nexus.krefty.area_grande_demais_ma: Area too large (max. %s blocks per side).
relic.nexus.krefty.mire_onde_a_construca: Aim where the building will go.
relic.nexus.krefty.a_area_nao_esta_limpa: The area isn't clear: %s blocks in the way.
relic.nexus.krefty.nenhum_bloco_desta_pl: No block in this blueprint is unlocked for you.
relic.nexus.krefty.para_erguer_copiar_e_: To build (copying is free): Capacity rank %s or higher, no blocks in the inventory, full health, hunger and mana.
relic.nexus.krefty.skill.0.desc: With a block in the off hand, right click places the block without consuming it, spending mana. Blocks with an inventory come out empty.
relic.nexus.krefty.skill.1.desc: Mark two points: for 60s the area blocks mobs and entities from entering. Whoever is inside gets hit by bricks; players wearing a helmet take no damage, but the helmet wears down.
relic.nexus.krefty.skill.2.desc: Copies the block you are looking at (up to 5 blocks), with its facing. Afterwards it is placed without needing to be in the off hand. Aiming at the air clears the copy.
relic.nexus.krefty.skill.3.desc: Mark two points: for 30s rubble falls. Non-allied mobs and players take damage, slowness and darkness.
relic.nexus.krefty.skill.4.desc: Without a blueprint in the off hand: mark two points to create the blueprint (free). With the blueprint in the off hand: builds it where you aim, if the area is clear.
relic.nexus.morpix.esse_dna_ja_esta_em: This DNA is already in use.
relic.nexus.morpix.cobaia_recebeu_o_dna_: Test subject received the DNA of %s.
relic.nexus.morpix.esse_dna_nao_pode_vir: This DNA can't become a form.
relic.nexus.morpix.agache_e_clique_com_o: Crouch and right click an ally or pet.
relic.nexus.morpix.forma_humana_sem_dna_: Human form (no DNA in use) and DNA in the syringe.
relic.nexus.morpix.skill.0.desc: Crouching and hitting a mob or player stores its DNA in the syringe (bosses from mastery 15).
relic.nexus.morpix.skill.1.desc: Consumes the DNA and gives you that mob's powers until the next Mimic. Right click uses the active power.
relic.nexus.morpix.skill.2.desc: Allows combining 2 different DNAs; a third replaces the oldest. Player DNA goes back to normal.
relic.nexus.morpix.skill.3.desc: Crouch + right click on an ally or pet applies the DNA to it until it dies (no bosses).
relic.nexus.morpix.skill.4.desc: Truly becomes the DNA's mob for 1 minute, stronger than the original. If the form dies, you return.
relic.nexus.necrix.so_um_mini_wither_por: Only one mini Wither at a time.
relic.nexus.necrix.1_stack_de_ossos_e: 1 stack of bones and 3 wither skeleton skulls (spent).
relic.nexus.necrix.skill.0.desc: Zombies and skeletons (and variants) don't attack you unless you attack first.
relic.nexus.necrix.skill.1.desc: Summons 5 skeleton warriors (pets) that improve with mastery. Using it again removes the old ones.
relic.nexus.necrix.skill.2.desc: 10-block field for 10s: damage per second; whoever dies in it becomes your skeleton guard. Whoever leaves gets Wither.
relic.nexus.necrix.skill.3.desc: Summons a mini Wither for up to 20s that attacks enemies with skulls. The cooldown starts when it dies.
relic.nexus.necrix.skill.4.desc: Immortal army of ~20 skeletons for 30s (fallen ones are replaced), with a mini Wither.
relic.nexus.oculty.olhe_para_um_jogador_: Look at a player to see their inventory.
relic.nexus.oculty.nenhum_mob_ou_jogador: No mob or player within 5 blocks and at least one within 100.
relic.nexus.oculty.skill.0.desc: On the head: night vision. Crouching: invisible, spending mana per second. Damage (taken or dealt) breaks it; mobs lose sight of you and glowing doesn't reveal you.
relic.nexus.oculty.skill.1.desc: Shrinks to the minimum size for a few seconds, with speed and super jump; then slowly grows back.
relic.nexus.oculty.skill.2.desc: Marks mobs and players in 15×15×15 with a glow only you see (hostile red, passive green, players blue).
relic.nexus.oculty.skill.3.desc: Smoke bomb: blinds those nearby and mobs lose their target. You get a random effect (with weakness).
relic.nexus.oculty.skill.4.desc: Become a spectator for 30s, with your body standing still. Returns early if someone comes within 5 blocks of the body. During the effect, the relic key shows the inventory of the player you are looking at.
relic.nexus.orix.o_toque_de_midas_nao: Midas Touch doesn't change this block (or the result isn't unlocked yet).
relic.nexus.orix.ressonancia_rank_a_ou_m: Resonance rank A or higher and at least 64 raw ores or gems in the inventory.
relic.nexus.orix.skill.0.desc: Broken stone, deepslate and blackstone, and killed hostile mobs, may yield raw ore. Chance and rarity grow with mastery; bosses always drop.
relic.nexus.orix.skill.1.desc: Highlights nearby ores (10×10×10, grows with Affinity) through walls, only for you.
relic.nexus.orix.skill.2.desc: Transforms the touched block: stone becomes ore; ore becomes a raw block or the next one up the scale.
relic.nexus.orix.skill.3.desc: Breaks every ore in 10×10×10 around you and sends the drops to the inventory.
relic.nexus.orix.skill.4.desc: Turns the surroundings into ores from the inventory and gives haste, speed and fortune for 60s. Whatever isn't mined goes back to normal.
relic.nexus.phoenixy.skill.0.desc: Fire, lava and burning (including draconic) heal you for the same amount as the damage.
relic.nexus.phoenixy.skill.1.desc: Allies and pets within 3 blocks get Fire of Life for 30s.
relic.nexus.phoenixy.skill.2.desc: For 10s, phoenix fire in a 5-block radius: burns enemies (water doesn't put it out) and heals you and the protected.
relic.nexus.phoenixy.skill.3.desc: The feather becomes an elytra. While flying, the relic key gives a boost (5%% of mana). Embers fall wherever you pass.
relic.nexus.phoenixy.skill.4.desc: On death, explodes in flames and is reborn with half health (15 min cooldown). Guaranteed deaths ignore it.
relic.nexus.rifty.todas_as_outras_habili: Every other Rifty skill must be on cooldown.
relic.nexus.rifty.skill.0.desc: Attacking without a target teleports up to 5 blocks where you look (stops before blocks). With an enemy within 4 blocks, aims the hit at it instead of teleporting.
relic.nexus.rifty.skill.1.desc: Tears a line of up to 15 blocks: full damage to every enemy in the way and you reappear at the end.
relic.nexus.rifty.skill.2.desc: Breaks the dimension on top of the target (up to 15 blocks): ~45%% of max health (half magic, half void). Executes mobs at 50%% health or less (players: 25%%). Bosses are never executed.
relic.nexus.rifty.skill.3.desc: Up to 20s outside reality: pass through blocks like scaffolding (jump to go up, crouch to go down), immune to physical damage. Doesn't interact with anything; attacking ends it. Spends mana while active.
relic.nexus.rifty.skill.4.desc: Black hole for 15s that pulls enemies, items and XP. The radius grows with each capture (10 → 100). With more than 10 captures, it explodes at the end.
relic.nexus.rupty.marca_mortal_preparada: Deadly Mark prepared: the next hit marks the target.
relic.nexus.rupty.ter_uma_espada_no_inve: Have a sword in the inventory (consumed on activation).
relic.nexus.rupty.skill.0.desc: Each hit creates a cut mark on the target: -5%% defense against the Rupty. Each mark lasts 20s (doesn't refresh). Max. 10 per target (50%%), bosses included. Reduction above 100%% becomes extra damage.
relic.nexus.rupty.skill.1.desc: Straight-line slash up to 5 blocks ahead, hitting everyone in the line: normal hit damage and 3 marks on each.
relic.nexus.rupty.skill.2.desc: 360° strike (radius 3) with 1.5× normal damage. 5 marks on those within 1.5 blocks, 3 on those further away; then pushes those hit.
relic.nexus.rupty.skill.3.desc: Existing marks double in effect and duration (10%% each, 40s) and each marked target loses half a heart every 2s.
relic.nexus.rupty.skill.4.desc: Consumes a sword from the inventory. The next hit applies a mark that only goes away with death: -50%% defense against the Rupty and, every 2s, half of the consumed sword's damage (damage enchantments count). Resists the totem.
relic.nexus.sculky.amplificador_ativo_e_: Amplifier active and Sound Pressure and Sculk Step ready.
relic.nexus.sculky.skill.0.desc: In hand: the Warden ignores you and the Sonic Boom doesn't hurt; you see vibrations within 16 blocks (outline of whoever made them).
relic.nexus.sculky.skill.1.desc: For 1 minute, improves every skill and the relic's passive.
relic.nexus.sculky.skill.2.desc: For 10s, bass beats around you: glowing, damage, knockback, nausea and interrupts whoever is eating or aiming.
relic.nexus.sculky.skill.3.desc: Creates a sculk patch for 1 min. Standing on sculk, teleports to the sculk of the same patch where you look.
relic.nexus.sculky.skill.4.desc: Fires a 30-block Sonic Boom that goes through everything: kills common mobs and badly hurts players and bosses.
relic.nexus.skopy.na_mosca_o_alvo_marcad: Bullseye: the marked target is gone.
relic.nexus.skopy.na_mosca_alvo_marcado_: Bullseye: target marked. The next shot goes straight to it.
relic.nexus.skopy.na_mosca_o_proximo_tir: Bullseye: the next shot marks the target.
relic.nexus.skopy.ghost_o_proximo_tiro_e: Ghost: the next shot is spectral.
relic.nexus.skopy.regeneracao_rank_a_ou_: Regeneration rank A or higher, no blindness, no arrows in the inventory and no mob or player within 5 blocks.
relic.nexus.skopy.skill.0.desc: Mana arrows (no arrows needed). Each hit applies glowing (only you see it) and a random negative effect.
relic.nexus.skopy.skill.1.desc: Total invisibility for a few seconds; mobs lose their target. The next shot has bonus damage and breaks the invisibility.
relic.nexus.skopy.skill.2.desc: The first shot marks the target for 15s; the second is teleported straight into it, a guaranteed hit.
relic.nexus.skopy.skill.3.desc: The next shot becomes spectral: no gravity, up to 200 blocks, goes through up to 3 obstacles.
relic.nexus.skopy.skill.4.desc: Instant shot of up to 1000 blocks that goes through everything. Damage = the target's current health, -1%% per obstacle (bosses: at most 50%%).
relic.nexus.souly.1_totem_no_inventario_: 1 totem in the inventory and an enemy player or boss within 200 blocks.
relic.nexus.souly.skill.0.desc: With a totem in the inventory, your killing blow cancels the target's totem (Eterny included), spending one on each side. Your totems trigger from the inventory, but you don't use a totem in hand. 10%% chance of a totem when killing a player or boss.
relic.nexus.souly.skill.1.desc: Darkness and Weakness around you. For up to 1 min, each hit steals max health from the target, which becomes yours (turns into absorption at the end).
relic.nexus.souly.skill.2.desc: For 30s: −2 hearts of max health, Strength II and Speed II; 25%% of damage dealt heals you.
relic.nexus.souly.skill.3.desc: Marks a player or boss for 5 min. With a totem (spent): double damage and each hit removes max health. If it dies to the Souly, it becomes a totem.
relic.nexus.souly.skill.4.desc: Spends every totem marking enemy players/bosses within 200 blocks. For 30s, crouching while looking at a marked one teleports you behind them.
relic.nexus.steely.so_um_golem_por_vez: Only one golem at a time.
relic.nexus.steely.o_guarda_costas_preci: The Bodyguard must be ready to use.
relic.nexus.steely.skill.0.desc: Worn: reduces all damage taken (20%% at level 1 up to 50%% at 20), up to 85%% together with armor and Resistance.
relic.nexus.steely.skill.1.desc: For 20s: Resistance II and immunity to magic attacks (relics included). Finals and guaranteed deaths ignore it.
relic.nexus.steely.skill.2.desc: Returns 15%% of the damage taken (before reductions) to the attacker, even at range.
relic.nexus.steely.skill.3.desc: Summons a half-size golem that deals double damage and protects you. The cooldown starts when it dies.
relic.nexus.steely.skill.4.desc: Become the Bodyguard for 3 min: ~50 hearts of absorption, double damage and punches that launch. Punches only.
relic.nexus.thiefy.olhe_para_um_jogador_: Look at a player up to 3 blocks away.
relic.nexus.thiefy.inventario_vazio_incl: Empty inventory, armor included (relics don't count).
relic.nexus.thiefy.skill.0.desc: When hitting, a chance (10%% to 30%%) to steal a stack from the target; a paper is left in its place. Without armor, you become invisible.
relic.nexus.thiefy.skill.1.desc: Opens the inventory of a player within 3 blocks for 5s, without them seeing, and you steal 1 item.
relic.nexus.thiefy.skill.2.desc: Creates a clone of you that draws enemies; you become fully invisible for 10s or until you attack.
relic.nexus.thiefy.skill.3.desc: For 5 min, you make no sound or vibration (unnoticed by the Warden and sculk).
relic.nexus.thiefy.skill.4.desc: Lists players and chests in a 20-block area; pick one and steal everything from it (except relics).
relic.nexus.trindy.a_area_de_caca_precis: Hunting Ground must be on cooldown.
relic.nexus.trindy.skill.0.desc: Works with Loyalty: when thrown, pulls the target hit to you. Crouching, it works like Riptide, even out of water.
relic.nexus.trindy.skill.1.desc: The next throw creates a 6-block vortex for 5s that pulls and hurts enemies.
relic.nexus.trindy.skill.2.desc: Surfs a wave for 15 blocks, pushing and hurting whoever is in the way.
relic.nexus.trindy.skill.3.desc: The next throw creates a 10-block area for 10s where sharks bite enemies every second.
relic.nexus.trindy.skill.4.desc: The next throw creates a lightning storm; at the end, a giant shark mouth devours the marked prey.
relic.nexus.venossy.estar_com_a_toxina_p: Have Potent Toxin and Paralyzing Poison on you.
relic.nexus.venossy.skill.0.desc: Immune to poison. Your hits poison (I, II at level 10, III at 20), even the undead, and the poison can kill.
relic.nexus.venossy.skill.1.desc: 3-block aura for 10s: enemies in it take double from your poison and your hits.
relic.nexus.venossy.skill.2.desc: Throws the dagger (it returns on its own): a toxin that removes half a heart every 5s until death. Only a totem removes it.
relic.nexus.venossy.skill.3.desc: Throws the dagger (it returns on its own): the target is fully paralyzed for 5s, even bosses.
relic.nexus.venossy.skill.4.desc: With both poisons on you, removes them and the next hit applies amplified versions with no cure.
relic.nexus.voltrix.estar_com_a_alta_vol: Have High Voltage active (Strength from a recent lightning bolt).
relic.nexus.voltrix.skill.0.desc: Lightning doesn't hurt you and gives Strength II for 5s (lightning from other relics included).
relic.nexus.voltrix.skill.1.desc: The next hit releases a bolt that jumps between enemies (3 blocks per jump), hurting and paralyzing.
relic.nexus.voltrix.skill.2.desc: For 30s, hits you deal or take paralyze the other side for 1s.
relic.nexus.voltrix.skill.3.desc: For 20s, lightning rains in a 10-block area (it may hit allies).
relic.nexus.voltrix.skill.4.desc: For 30s, every hit makes lightning strike the target, as extra damage.
relic.nexus.trindy.a_presa_escapou_mas_f: The prey escaped... but it was marked.
relic.nexus.draconix.ovo_nao_pronto: The egg isn't ready yet (max mastery).
relic.nexus.draconix.ovo_precisa_ender_d: The egg only hatches for those who defeated the Ender Dragon.
relic.nexus.draconix.ovo_desligue_pele: Turn off Scaly Skin to hatch the egg.
relic.nexus.draconix.ovo_tire_armadura: Take off your armor to hatch the egg.
nexus.configuration.generateMagicStatusO: Generate magic status on first join
If true, generates the magic status the first time the player joins the world. If false, only when interacting with the Crystal Ball.
nexus.configuration.custoPadrao.tooltip: Default mana cost per block placed by the Krefty.
nexus.configuration.custosPorBloco.toolt: Cost and minimum mastery per block or tag: "id=cost@level" or "#tag=cost@level". The first match wins (ids before tags). Always blocked: tag nexus:krefty_bloqueados.
nexus.configuration.ladoMaximoArea.toolt: Max side of the Construction and Demolition Areas.
nexus.configuration.ladoMaximoPlanta.too: Max side of an Instant Construction blueprint.
nexus.configuration.coresSonar.tooltip: Sonar outline color per ore tag: "tag=RRGGBB" (the first match wins).
nexus.configuration.midas.tooltip: Midas Touch: "block=result". Stone, deepslate and blackstone become a random ore (fixed in code).
nexus.configuration.efeitosMix.tooltip: Mix: random effects applied by the pellets (no instant damage).
nexus.configuration.ovosEmGeradores.tool: Allows using Back to the Egg eggs in mob spawners.
nexus.configuration.limiteAnimais.toolti: Population Growth: above this number of animals in the area, it doesn't speed up.
nexus.configuration.tabelas.tooltip: Fish Anywhere: "place=item:weight,item:weight". Places: terra, areia, neve, lava, nether, end.
nexus.configuration.aquaticos.tooltip: Fish of Life: random passive or neutral aquatic mobs.
nexus.configuration.poderes.tooltip: Borrowed Power: "mob=power". Powers: lobo, gato, papagaio, cavalo, lhama, camelo, axolote, nautilo.
advancements.nexus.despertar_da_mana.des: Discover your mana status at the Crystal Ball.
advancements.nexus.mestre_nexus.title: Nexus Master
advancements.nexus.mestre_nexus.descript: Reach 1000 in all four mana stats.
advancements.nexus.um_com_o_nexus.title: One with the Nexus
advancements.nexus.um_com_o_nexus.descri: Reach rank S in Capacity, Regeneration, Affinity and Resonance.
